title: Require Domain Source Topology
forbids: domain roots outside the positive aggregate and semantic-child spine
why: A domain root is one public contract and router boundary over direct semantic subdomains. Child blueprints own branch internals.
remediate: Keep index.ts, contract.ts, and router.ts; retain only semantic child directories and relocate legacy root cabinets behind their rightful subdomain.
message: Domain roots must match the positive domain blueprint spine.
